name: diamond
title: Diamond import: two arms share one leaf module
description: Top imports left (Nand) and right (Nor); both import the same leaf (Inv). The shared module binds once by name (AMB-27 program-global identity) and the diamond flattens to NAND on Na and NOR on No, depth 2.
